1.explanation:
1. We create a simple CascaderSelect with one parent and two child nodes.
2. We enable multiple selection and showSearch.
3. In the browser, type “Item” in the search box: both leaf items appear.
4. Click to check “Item A” and “Item B” – now all filtered items are selected.
5. Observe that the search input and the filtered list remain visible, instead of auto-clearing back to the full tree. This reproduces the bug described in the report.
1.bug_scenario: When using CascaderSelect in multiple + showSearch mode, if the user types a search keyword (e.g. "Item") and then manually checks every result in the filtered list, the search input is not cleared and the dropdown remains stuck in the filtered state. The user cannot see the full tree again until they close & re-open the popup, which is confusing.
